instructions: Reappraise the proposer's intentions and behavior as more negative for up-regulation, less negative for down-regulation, or perceive the situation spontaneously without a particular interpretation for look. Press a button to advance to the next trial.

steps: Spatial normalization to individual high-resolution T1-weighted scan

hrf_model: Canonical hemodynamic response function and its temporal derivative

stimuli: Sad and disgusting videos selected from previous research and public online resources such as YouTube
Three neutral videos
Embedded video of a familiarized person watching and responding to the videos
Video titles and suggested regulation phrases
Sadness
Disgust
Neutral videos
instructions: Select one suggested strategy, vocalize it during the first 5 s of the video, and continue implementing it. Regulate one's own emotion in the intrapersonal scan and help the other person regulate their emotion in the interpersonal scan. Watch without regulating in control trials. Rate emotional experience and difficulty after each trial.
performance_measures: 7-point Likert ratings of one's own or the other person's emotional experience
7-point Likert ratings of difficulty following instructions

education_summary: First or second year undergraduate English students.

steps: Slice-timing correction to the first slice
Extraction of noise components via Melodic ICA, guided by Kelly et al., 2010
High-pass filtering estimated in individual scans
Linear boundary-based registration to anatomical counterpart

hrf_model: Standard canonical gamma function implemented in FSL (lag, 6 sec; width, 3 sec); temporal derivatives included.
estimator: Metropolis-Hastings Markov Chain Monte Carlo sampling
generalized least squares (ordinary least squares after whitening)

stimuli: 24 poetic and 24 prosaic stimuli, each four lines long; 12 expected and 12 unexpected in each linguistic category
Simple math equations presented for 6 seconds before each piece
instructions: Read and consider each poetic and prosaic piece as best they could, and then reflect on the meaning they had derived from the piece.
performance_measures: Postscan ratings of poeticness, need to reappraise meaning, understanding of meaning, and valence

diagnostic_instrument: Schedule for Interviewing DSM-IV Personality Disorders-IV (SIDP-IV)

steps: Normalization to a standard Montreal Neurological Institute template
Spatial smoothing with a Gaussian kernel

stimuli: International Affective Pictures System (IAPS) images depicting negative and neutral interpersonal situations
Auditory maintain and suppress instructions
Relax screen
instructions: For distance, relate to the image as though personally unconnected to the pictured individuals or context, like an anthropologist or emergency room doctor maintaining a detached clinical perspective. For look, allow the spontaneously evoked emotion. Do not close the eyes or look away. Rate emotional reactions after each picture.
performance_measures: Emotional valence ratings from 1 (very negative) to 5 (very positive)
Post-scan debriefing reports of task compliance
